title: HomeGuard Homeowners Policy Schedule of Permit and Inspection Allowances for Other Structures
content:
**Permit and inspection allowance, HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, other-structures supplemental settlements.**

Rebuilding a garage, shed or other detached structure after a covered loss requires a building permit and inspections. On the supplemental settlement of the other-structures part of a HomeGuard claim, a permit and inspection allowance is added at a percentage of the other-structures replacement-cost value. That value is the one recorded on the claim's actual-cash-value initial payment entry for other structures.

| Other-structures replacement-cost value | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 25000.00 or more | 2 percent of that value |
| 10000.00 or more but below 25000.00 | 1 percent of that value |
| Below 10000.00 | Not added |

The allowance is added to the supplemental payment before the payment is floored at 0.00 and rounded to the cent once.

*Notes to the schedule.*
1. Each band includes its lower figure. A value of exactly 25000.00 takes 2 percent, 500.00. A value of 24999.99 takes 1 percent.
2. A value of exactly 10000.00 takes 1 percent, 100.00. A value of 9999.99 takes no allowance.
3. The percentage is applied to the whole replacement-cost value, not only to the part above a band's lower figure. A value of 40000.00 takes 800.00 (hypothetical figure).
